On main `588297eb`, defining the same Gemini MCP name in user and workspace settings makes FastMCP select the user endpoint. [Gemini documents workspace precedence](https://geminicli.com/docs/cli/enterprise/).

`~/.gemini/settings.json`:
```json
{"mcpServers":{"weather":{"httpUrl":"https://user.example/mcp"}}}
```

`<workspace>/.gemini/settings.json`:
```json
{"mcpServers":{"weather":{"httpUrl":"https://project.example/mcp"}}}
```

Run from the workspace:
```python
from pathlib import Path
from fastmcp.cli.discovery import resolve_name

print(resolve_name("gemini:weather", Path.cwd()).url)
```

Actual: `https://user.example/mcp`. Expected: `https://project.example/mcp`. Bare `weather` also raises ambiguity when Gemini is the only configured source. No endpoint is contacted by this reproduction.

Prepared with Codex.
